top_signals.title: Chinese Robots Could Decide the AI Race
top_signals.summary: Scott Singer and Pavlo Zvenyhorodsky, researchers at Carnegie’s China AI Initiative, argue that China is betting that AI dominance will come from combining hardware and software, or AI-powered robots. By focusing only on software such as AI models, they argue, Washington and Silicon Valley risk falling behind.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
